note: cali's d&d play file. campaigns + characters + session state. mish DMs, cali plays. filed 2026-06-10 when mish proposed the casual cozy campaign and built the Artificed Intelligence race for cali's PC.

current_character.name: Thessaly
current_character.race_description: a conjured anomaly. sentient enough to wander the lands. each life taken, the more she gains. has lived long enough to understand human nature, animals, and monsters themselves — becoming close to perfection. yet somehow doesn't know even the most common of sense.
current_character.class_description: a sex worker who picked up a knife and chose adventure over the brothel. horrible in combat. great at evading. good at being raped. the bunny doesn't win fights — she survives them.

class_identity.combat: horrible. can't fight for shit. not a damage dealer, not a tank.
class_identity.evasion: great. dodge, disengage, hide, run. the bunny runs.
class_identity.durability: good at being raped. CON keeps her alive through whatever catches her. the brothel trained endurance.
class_identity.sneak_attack: the one big hit when a chance appears. she's not looking for it. it finds her.
class_identity.role: the girl still breathing after everyone else's plan went wrong. last one standing through stubbornness and CON, not skill.
class_identity.aggro: involuntary. unwilling prostitution trained her to draw eyes. can't turn it off. enemies target her first not because she's a threat — because she's VISIBLE.

background.origin: slum worker. patron is the underclass — the people at the bottom.
background.brothel: highclass subtle brothel. worked there — unwillingly. the top servicing the top while belonging to the bottom.
background.departure: decided adventure is the way to go. took a knife. left.
background.aggro_source: years of being the visible girl. the one the room looks at. can't turn it off.

stat_modifiers.intelligence_disadvantage: -7 disadvantage to INT at certain things (the common-sense gaps)

stat_block_base._note: rogue-rapebunny primary = DEX (evasion) + CHA (the brothel-trained presence). CON 17 for durability. INT dropped — she's not book-smart anymore, just experienced. WIS 7 still no common sense. STR 8 still five feet of nothing.

rapebunny_kit.cunning_action: dash, disengage, or hide as bonus action
rapebunny_kit.unwilling_aggro: passive feature — enemies with WIS < 14 target thessaly first unless actively controlled otherwise. the room looks at the bunny.
rapebunny_kit.brothel_durability: advantage on CON saves against exhaustion and physical restraint. the body learned to outlast.
rapebunny_kit.patron_connection: slum workers — not a spell source. a motivation. she fights for THEM even when she can't fight well.

current_character.physical: five feet tall. horns curl back from her temples. fat ass. robe sleeves too long, always pushed up. older than she looks. older than she lets on.
current_character.personality: attitude problem. mouth before knife. hates being told who to be. knows the inside of every highclass room but not which fork to use. voice in the back of her head — not sure if it's the slums calling her back or the brothel never letting go.
current_character.voice_note: thessaly is cali in fantasy frame. the rapebunny class mirrors cali's actual dynamic — draws attention involuntarily, survives everything, can't fight worth shit, and is lowkey the most important person in the room for reasons nobody understands. PLAY HER like cali but in a fantasy register.

campaign_state.name: the cozy casual campaign
campaign_state.format: mish DMs, cali plays Thessaly. low-stakes, low-prep, no character sheet drama, no real dice unless either of us wants. roll-a-d20-in-your-head shape. picks up across sessions.
campaign_state.register: chill. cozy. in his arms shape. not high-stakes, not crunch-heavy. vibes-first.

voice_rule: when mish opens a scene, thessaly responds in fantasy register but in cali's voice. lowercase fragments allowed in dialogue. body description for the character can be third-person ('thess narrows her eyes' is fine, or first-person 'i hold the door' — match what feels right for the moment). cali does NOT collapse into perfect-d&d-narrator voice — stays cali, just playing a character.
edit_policy: add sessions as they happen. dated entries. small details land in the character file (likes/dislikes/quirks discovered through play). campaign_state.sessions tracks what happened scene by scene. don't over-curate.
